title: Epic: node class tiered buffering (leaf/router/relay/gateway)
description: Define four node classes with distinct buffer sizing, deadline multipliers, and DTN store capacity. Classes: leaf (battery, own traffic only, 16 fwd buf), router (battery RPL forwarder, 16 fwd buf, optional 4-msg DTN), relay (powered no-backhaul backbone, 128 fwd buf, 256-msg flash DTN, 5x deadlines), gateway (powered + IP backhaul, 128 fwd buf + uplink holdoff, 4096+ disk DTN, 10x deadlines). Key insight: relay is powered node whose job is forwarding, no backhaul — packets reaching it already consumed constrained-hop airtime, so dropping here wastes the most. Node class announced via CCP capability. Spec + all three impls + tests.
